description: Read recorded sale dates and prices for one exact King, Pierce or Snohomish County parcel, from the county assessor's own published sale records (up to the last three years). Each record gives the parcel count, the county's market-validity code and whether it can serve as a comparable sale; multi-parcel, nominal and unverified prices are flagged, not hidden. No buyer, seller or owner names. Use address or county plus parcelId. A miss is not an answer and is not charged; missing records do not prove that no sale occurred, and a sale price is not a current value. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.
name: wa_sale_history
title: Recorded sale history for one property
